answer: A jet engine pulls air in, squeezes it, burns fuel in it and shoots the hot gas out the back, which pushes the plane forward.
title: How a jet engine pushes
caption: air in, squeeze, burn, fast gas out

beats.say: I can see pictures of jets from a picture search. This page does not explain how a jet works, so here is how its engine does it.
A big fan at the front pulls air into the engine.
The compressor squeezes that air into a small space.
Fuel burns in the squeezed air, so the gas gets very hot and wants to spread out.
The hot gas spins a turbine, which keeps the fan turning, and then it rushes out the back.
Gas shooting backward pushes the engine forward. That push is called thrust.
